decisions.reason: The modular mobile plant concept combines the firm's core shredding and screening know-how, and the quantified customer savings show the firm can read and use early market results.
A slow-speed shredder sits at the heart of the firm's established knowledge base, and its dedicated page signals strategic commitment.
This second modular plant concept builds on related knowledge but overlaps with Product A and has no reported results, so it may be merged into A, though keeping it is still more likely.
Trommel screens are a long-standing core competence, so the firm can assimilate feedback and improve the product through its own R&D.
